name: ontology-forge
description: Design and extend a Palantir Foundry ontology the domain-driven way: interview the domain, shape object types, links, interfaces and actions, then map source data and logic onto them.

interface.shortDescription: Drive a Foundry ontology design, domain first
interface.longDescription: Run the four stages of ontology design from one command — understand the domain, design the object model, map source data and logic, write the data contracts — with a checkpoint at every stage boundary and the position, open questions, and unconfirmed decisions carried in ontology/STATUS.md between sessions. Contracts conform strictly to Open Data Contract Standard v3.1.0 and are validated against its JSON schema. Palantir's best practices, structural guidance, and anti-pattern catalog are applied throughout.
defaultPrompt: Take me through designing an ontology for this domain
Continue the ontology where we left off
Write ODCS data contracts for these sources
